title: Exterior presheaf under open pullback
statement: For a scheme X, an O_X-module M, a natural number n and an open U, the presheaf pullback along U.ι of the sectionwise exterior-power presheaf is isomorphic to the sectionwise exterior-power presheaf of M.restrict U.ι.

proof.text: Use the image-preimage adjunction for the open immersion to identify presheaf pullback with restriction to image opens and scalar transport along the canonical ring isomorphisms. On each open, map pure wedges using the module restriction isomorphism; the inverse uses the inverse ring isomorphism. The composites and naturality hold on pure wedges and extend by exteriorPower.linearMap_ext.
